#Read in Data
```{r, include=TRUE}
FullTotals <- readRDS("fulltotals.rds")

PrePostTotals <- readRDS("preposttotals.rds")
```

# SWB & CEI - Regressed Change
```{r, include=TRUE}

RegChange_SWLS <- lm(Post_SWLS ~ Pre_SWLS + condition_dummy, PrePostTotals)
summary(RegChange_SWLS)

RegChange_PA <- lm(Post_PA ~ Pre_PA + condition_dummy, PrePostTotals)
summary(RegChange_PA)

RegChange_NA <- lm(Post_NA ~ Pre_NA + condition_dummy, PrePostTotals)
summary(RegChange_NA)

RegChange_CEI <- lm(Post_CEI ~ Pre_CEI + condition_dummy, PrePostTotals)
summary(RegChange_CEI)

RegChange_CEIStretch <- lm(Post_CEI.Stretch ~ Pre_CEI.Stretch + condition_dummy, PrePostTotals)
summary(RegChange_CEIStretch)

RegChange_CEIEmbrace <- lm(Post_CEI.Embrace ~ Pre_CEI.Embrace + condition_dummy, PrePostTotals)
summary(RegChange_CEIEmbrace)

#Effort
RegChange_SWLSeff <- lm(Post_SWLS ~ Pre_SWLS + condition_dummy*CompletedCheckins, PrePostTotals)
summary(RegChange_SWLSeff)

RegChange_PAeff <- lm(Post_PA ~ Pre_PA + condition_dummy*CompletedCheckins, PrePostTotals)
summary(RegChange_PAeff)

RegChange_NAeff <- lm(Post_NA ~ Pre_NA + condition_dummy*CompletedCheckins, PrePostTotals)
summary(RegChange_NAeff)

RegChange_CEIeff <- lm(Post_CEI ~ Pre_CEI + condition_dummy*CompletedCheckins, PrePostTotals)
summary(RegChange_CEIeff)

RegChange_CEIStretcheff <- lm(Post_CEI.Stretch ~ Pre_CEI.Stretch*condition_dummy + CompletedCheckins, PrePostTotals)
summary(RegChange_CEIStretcheff)

RegChange_CEIEmbraceeff <- lm(Post_CEI.Embrace ~ Pre_CEI.Embrace*condition_dummy + CompletedCheckins, PrePostTotals)
summary(RegChange_CEIEmbraceeff)

PrePostTotals$CEI_change <- PrePostTotals$Post_CEI - PrePostTotals$Pre_CEI
ggplot(PrePostTotals, 
       aes(x = CompletedCheckins, y = CEI_change)) + 
       geom_point() + 
       labs(title = "Trait Curiosity by # of Completed Daily Check-Ins",
       x = "Completed Check-ins",
       y = "Changes in Trait Curiosity") 

PrePostTotals$CompletedCheckinsSqd <- PrePostTotals$CompletedCheckins^2

RegChange_CEICheckins <- lm(Post_CEI ~ Pre_CEI + CompletedCheckins, PrePostTotals)
summary(RegChange_CEICheckins)

RegChange_CEICheckinsSqd <- lm(Post_CEI ~ Pre_CEI + CompletedCheckins + CompletedCheckinsSqd, PrePostTotals)
summary(RegChange_CEICheckinsSqd)

RegChange_CEICheckinsSqdCond <- lm(Post_CEI ~ Pre_CEI + condition_dummy*CompletedCheckins 
                                   + condition_dummy*CompletedCheckinsSqd, PrePostTotals)
summary(RegChange_CEICheckinsSqdCond)
```

# Exploratory Hypotheses - Thriving
```{r, include=TRUE}
day0_TotalsCIT <- readRDS("day0_TotalsCIT.rds")
day8_TotalsCIT <- readRDS("day8_TotalsCIT.rds")

PrePostCIT <- merge(day0_TotalsCIT, day8_TotalsCIT, all = F)
describe(PrePostCIT)
table(PrePostCIT$Condition)
describeBy(PrePostCIT, group = PrePostCIT$Condition)

RegChange_CIT.Support <- lm(Post_CITSupport ~ Pre_CITSupport + condition_dummy, PrePostCIT)
summary(RegChange_CIT.Support)

RegChange_CIT.Lonely <- lm(Post_CITLonely ~ Pre_CITLonely + condition_dummy, PrePostCIT)
summary(RegChange_CIT.Lonely)

RegChange_CIT.Lonely_social <- lm(Post_CITLonely ~ Pre_CITLonely + condition_dummy*Daily_social_percent, PrePostCIT) #social moderator
summary(RegChange_CIT.Lonely_social)

RegChange_CIT.Belong <- lm(Post_CITBelong ~ Pre_CITBelong + condition_dummy, PrePostCIT)
summary(RegChange_CIT.Belong)

RegChange_CIT.Engage <- lm(Post_CITEngage ~ Pre_CITEngage + condition_dummy, PrePostCIT)
summary(RegChange_CIT.Engage)

RegChange_CIT.Skills <- lm(Post_CITSkills ~ Pre_CITSkills + condition_dummy, PrePostCIT)
summary(RegChange_CIT.Skills)

RegChange_CIT.Learn <- lm(Post_CITLearn ~ Pre_CITLearn + condition_dummy, PrePostCIT)
summary(RegChange_CIT.Learn)

RegChange_CIT.Accomplish <- lm(Post_CITAccom ~ Pre_CITAccom + condition_dummy, PrePostCIT)
summary(RegChange_CIT.Accomplish)

RegChange_CIT.SelfEfficacy <- lm(Post_CITSelfEff ~ Pre_CITSelfEff + condition_dummy, PrePostCIT)
summary(RegChange_CIT.SelfEfficacy)

RegChange_CIT.SelfWorth <- lm(Post_CITSelfWorth ~ Pre_CITSelfWorth + condition_dummy, PrePostCIT)
summary(RegChange_CIT.SelfWorth)

RegChange_CIT.Control <- lm(Post_CITControl ~ Pre_CITControl + condition_dummy, PrePostCIT)
summary(RegChange_CIT.Control)

RegChange_CIT.Meaning <- lm(Post_CITMean ~ Pre_CITMean + condition_dummy, PrePostCIT)
summary(RegChange_CIT.Meaning)

RegChange_CIT.Optimism <- lm(Post_CITOpt ~ Pre_CITOpt + condition_dummy, PrePostCIT)
summary(RegChange_CIT.Optimism)
```

# Calc Effect Size
```{r, include=TRUE}
PrePostTotals.Curiosity <- PrePostTotals %>% filter(PrePostTotals$Condition == "curiosity")
PrePostTotals.Curiosity <- PrePostTotals.Curiosity %>% filter(!is.na(PrePostTotals.Curiosity$Post_PA))
PrePostTotals.Curiosity <- PrePostTotals.Curiosity %>% filter(!is.na(PrePostTotals.Curiosity$Post_BMPNauto))

CurPAttest <- t.test(PrePostTotals.Curiosity$Post_PA, PrePostTotals.Curiosity$Pre_PA, paired=T)
cohens_d(CurPAttest)

CurNAttest <- t.test(PrePostTotals.Curiosity$Post_NA, PrePostTotals.Curiosity$Pre_NA, paired=T)
cohens_d(CurNAttest)

CurAutottest <- t.test(PrePostTotals.Curiosity$Post_BMPNauto, PrePostTotals.Curiosity$Pre_BMPNauto, paired=T)
cohens_d(CurAutottest)

CurCompttest <- t.test(PrePostTotals.Curiosity$Post_BMPNcomp, PrePostTotals.Curiosity$Pre_BMPNcomp, paired=T)
CurCompttest
cohens_d(CurCompttest)

PrePostCIT.Curiosity <- PrePostCIT %>% filter(PrePostCIT$Condition == "curiosity")
PrePostCIT.Curiosity <- PrePostCIT.Curiosity %>% filter(!is.na(PrePostCIT.Curiosity$Post_CITSelfWorth))

CurSWttest <- t.test(PrePostCIT.Curiosity$Post_CITSelfWorth, PrePostCIT.Curiosity$Pre_CITSelfWorth, paired=T)
CurSWttest
cohens_d(CurSWttest)

PrePostTotals.Control <- PrePostTotals %>% filter(PrePostTotals$Condition == "control")
PrePostTotals.Control <- PrePostTotals.Control %>% filter(!is.na(PrePostTotals.Control$Post_NA))

ConNAttest <- t.test(PrePostTotals.Control$Post_NA, PrePostTotals.Control$Pre_NA, paired=T)
cohens_d(ConNAttest)

ConPAttest <- t.test(PrePostTotals.Control$Post_PA, PrePostTotals.Control$Pre_PA, paired=T)
cohens_d(ConPAttest)

ConAutottest <- t.test(PrePostTotals.Control$Post_BMPNauto, PrePostTotals.Control$Pre_BMPNauto, paired=T)
ConAutottest

PrePostCIT.Control <- PrePostCIT %>% filter(PrePostCIT$Condition == "control")
PrePostCIT.Control <- PrePostCIT.Control %>% filter(!is.na(PrePostCIT.Control$Post_CITSelfWorth))

ConSWttest <- t.test(PrePostCIT.Control$Post_CITSelfWorth, PrePostCIT.Control$Pre_CITSelfWorth, paired=T)
ConSWttest
cohens_d(ConSWttest)

#Weekly Negative Affect estimate comparing difference scores
PrePostTotals <- PrePostTotals %>% mutate(Diff_NA = Post_NA - Pre_NA) 
NADiffttest <- t.test(Diff_NA ~ Condition, PrePostTotals, var.equal = T)
NADiffttest
t_to_d(t = NADiffttest$statistic, NADiffttest$parameter)
```

# Graphics of Regressed Changes
```{r, include=TRUE}
day0_Totals2 <- subset(day0data, select= c(Participant.ID, Condition, Pre_SWLS, Pre_PA, Pre_NA, Pre_CEI, Pre_BMPNauto, Pre_BMPNcomp))
day0_Totals2$day <- 0

#Rename Day 0 Data
names(day0_Totals2)[names(day0_Totals2) == "Pre_SWLS"] <- "SWLS"
names(day0_Totals2)[names(day0_Totals2) == "Pre_PA"] <- "PA"
names(day0_Totals2)[names(day0_Totals2) == "Pre_NA"] <- "NA"
names(day0_Totals2)[names(day0_Totals2) == "Pre_CEI"] <- "CEI"
names(day0_Totals2)[names(day0_Totals2) == "Pre_BMPNauto"] <- "BMPNauto"
names(day0_Totals2)[names(day0_Totals2) == "Pre_BMPNcomp"] <- "BMPNcomp"

day8_Totals2 <- subset(day8data, select= c(Participant.ID, Condition, Post_SWLS, Post_PA, Post_NA, Post_CEI, Post_BMPNauto, Post_BMPNcomp))
day8_Totals2$day <- 8

#Rename Day 8 Data
names(day8_Totals2)[names(day8_Totals2) == "Post_SWLS"] <- "SWLS"
names(day8_Totals2)[names(day8_Totals2) == "Post_PA"] <- "PA"
names(day8_Totals2)[names(day8_Totals2) == "Post_NA"] <- "NA"
names(day8_Totals2)[names(day8_Totals2) == "Post_CEI"] <- "CEI"
names(day8_Totals2)[names(day8_Totals2) == "Post_BMPNauto"] <- "BMPNauto"
names(day8_Totals2)[names(day8_Totals2) == "Post_BMPNcomp"] <- "BMPNcomp"

PrePostTotals2 <- merge(day0_Totals2, day8_Totals2, by = "Participant.ID")
#write.csv(PrePostTotals2, "PrePostTotals2.csv", row.names=FALSE)
PrePostTotals2_long <- read.csv("PrePostTotals2.csv") 

# Plot of Weekly PA
ggplot(PrePostTotals2_long, aes(x = as.factor(Condition), y = PA, group = day, fill = Condition)) +
  geom_bar(position=position_dodge(width = .91), stat='summary', fun='mean') + 
  labs(title = "Title",
       x = "Day",
       y = "Weekly Positive Affect") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(NA,7)) 
  

# Plot of Weekly NA
ggplot(PrePostTotals2_long, aes(x = as.factor(day), y = NA., group = Condition, fill = Condition)) +
  geom_bar(position=position_dodge(width = .91), stat='summary', fun='mean') + 
  labs(title = "Title",
       x = "Day",
       y = "Weekly Negative Affect") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,7))
  #geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("versicolor", "virginica")), map_signif_level=TRUE)
```

#Day 8 Social & Novel Moderation Graphics
```{r, include=TRUE}
Moderationlong <- FullTotals %>% select(c("Participant.ID", "Pre_BMPNauto", "Post_BMPNauto", "Pre_BMPNcomp", "Post_BMPNcomp", "Pre_BMPNrelate", "Post_BMPNrelate", "Condition", "condition_dummy", "Daily_social_percent", "Daily_novelty_percent")) 
Moderationlong <- pivot_longer(Moderationlong, c("Pre_BMPNauto", "Post_BMPNauto")) 
Moderationlong <- mutate(Moderationlong, )

Moderationlong <- pivot_longer(Moderationlong, c("Pre_BMPNcomp", "Post_BMPNcomp"))

#"Pre_BMPNcomp", "Post_BMPNcomp", "Pre_BMPNrelate", "Post_BMPNrelate"

ggplot(FullTotals, 
       aes(x = CheckinDay, y = Daily_PA, group = interaction(Condition, latinx_dummy), color = latinx_dummy, shape = Condition)) + 
       geom_point(stat = 'summary', fun = 'mean') + 
       geom_line(stat = 'summary', fun = 'mean') + 
       labs(title = "Average Daily PA by Condition and Latinx vs. Not",
       x = "Intervention Day",
       y = "Daily PA") +
       scale_y_continuous(limits=c(1,7))

```
